theater: 恰帕斯高地托尼納城址

battle.name: 第十一次「星際大戰」
battle.theater: 恰帕斯高地托尼納城址
battle.brief: 公元711年8月28日，瑪雅長紀曆9.13.19.13.3，恰好帕斯高地的托尼納以一次「星際大戰」攻破烏蘇馬辛塔河下游的帕倫基，擒其國王坎·喬伊·奇塔姆二世，令帕倫基王統中斷十年。卡面的羅馬弩砲以扭力簧束發射單支鐵矢，與星戰同構：城牆一破，城邦即非城邦。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 這場戰爭爆發於公元711年8月，交戰方是瑪雅西部區兩座獨立的城邦王國。勝方是托尼納（Toniná）：城址在墨西哥恰帕斯州奧科辛戈東約十三公里，位於海拔八百至九百公尺的恰帕斯高地，核心區沿一條易守的上升石灰岩脊展開，緊貼哈塔泰河的一條季節性支流；城中廟宇與金字塔群分層築在台地上，另有下沉式球場與百件以上的雕刻紀念物，銘文體例以圓雕風格著稱。托尼納並無常備國軍，兵員由王畿村社徵召、菁英突擊隊與球場隊伍組成，軍權與祭祀曆算都握在王室與祭司集團手中。敗方是帕倫基（Palenque）：城址在烏蘇馬辛塔河下游低地，瑪雅語稱拉卡姆哈（大水），祭祀中心已探得二點五平方公里，估計不足一成被揭開，仍有逾千座建築埋在叢林之下；其王統名單連續可考，711年在位者為基尼奇·坎·喬伊·奇塔姆二世。第三方是帕倫基的另一宿敵卡拉克穆爾，以及被托尼納碑銘提到的安納克一類附庸城邦。城邦之間沒有宣戰程序，聯盟與命令全靠盟誓、婚盟與祭祀曆法維繫。
countriesEn: This war broke out in August AD 711 between two independent city-state polities in the western Maya region. The victor was Toniná: the site lies in the Mexican state of Chiapas, some thirteen kilometres east of the town of Ocosingo, at an altitude of eight hundred to nine hundred metres in the Chiapas Highlands, its core spread along a rising limestone ridge that is easy to defend, immediately west of a seasonal tributary of the Jataté river. The temples and temple-pyramids of the city rise in tiers on the terraces, and there is a sunken ballcourt together with more than one hundred carved monuments, the epigraphic style of the city being notable for its in-the-round sculpture. Toniná had no standing national army: its men came from the levies of the villages round the capital, from elite strike bands and from ballgame teams, and both the war command and the ritual calendar lay with the royal house and the priestly order. The defeated side was Palenque, whose site lies in the lowland forest of the lower Usumacinta, called Lakamha, 'big water', in Maya; of its ceremonial precinct two and a half square kilometres have been uncovered, less than a tenth of the whole, and more than a thousand structures remain under the jungle. Its dynastic list runs continuously, and the ruler in 711 was K'inich K'an Joy Chitam II. Third parties were Palenque's other great rival, Calakmul, and client towns such as Annak' named on Toniná's monuments. There was no formal declaration of war between the cities: the alliance and its orders rested on oaths, marriage ties and the shared ritual calendar.
people: 主角一方的托尼納君主是第四任統治者基尼奇·丘瓦赫·卡克（K'inich Chuwaaj(?) K'ahk'）：他在708年即位時年紀極輕，711年那場大勝時仍是一名孩童，卻在位三年便打下帕倫基。托尼納的前任者尤克努姆·瓦希（Yukno'm Wahy）於668年即位，其統治以好戰與碑上常見的綑縛俘虜像為特徵；一塊682年的紀念物刻著三名被縛的裸體俘虜，其中一人被指為安納克的地方首領；他的統治可能以687年9月被帕倫基的基尼奇·坎·巴蘭姆二世擊敗並擒去收場。帕倫基方面，國王基尼奇·坎·喬伊·奇塔姆二世自702年在位，於711年被擒，據說後來在托尼納被處決，也有學者認為他被扣作人質。戰後帕倫基有十年無王，直到722年基尼奇·阿卡爾·莫·納布三世加冕，而新王是否直系後裔並無證據。背景人物包括帕倫基最著名的君主基尼奇·雅納布·巴卡爾（615至683年在位），其陵寢在碑銘神廟出土；以及主持托尼納發掘的考古學家皮埃爾·貝克隆、克洛德·博德茲與胡安·亞德溫（INAH，1972至1975年、1979年起）。
peopleEn: The ruler at the centre of the winning side was the fourth ruler of Toniná, K'inich Chuwaaj(?) K'ahk': he came to the throne in 708 at a very young age and was still a child when, in 711, Toniná won the great victory over Palenque, a city it brought down within three years of his accession. His predecessor, Yukno'm Wahy, took the throne in 668, and his reign is marked by warfare and by the bound captive figures that recur on the monuments; a monument of 682 shows three naked prisoners with their arms bound, one of them identified as a lord of the as yet unidentified town of Annak', and his reign may have ended with his defeat and capture by K'inich Kan Balam II of Palenque in September 687. On the Palenque side, the king K'inich K'an Joy Chitam II reigned from 702 until he was taken prisoner in 711; the accounts say that he was afterwards executed at Toniná, while other scholars hold that he was kept as a hostage. Palenque then had no king for ten years, until K'inich Ahkal Mo' Nahb III was crowned in 722, and there is no evidence that the new king was a direct heir. Among the background figures is the most famous ruler of Palenque, K'inich Janaab' Pakal, who reigned from 615 to 683 and whose tomb was excavated in the Temple of the Inscriptions, together with the archaeologists Pierre Becquelin, Claude Baudez and Juan Yadeun of INAH, who directed the excavations at Toniná in 1972 to 1975 and again from 1979 onward.
kits: 任務單上的兵器是羅馬弩砲（Scorpio）：公元前一世紀出現的扭力式單發弩砲，以搓成束的獸筋與馬鬃蓄能，一發一具約一公尺長的鐵矢、前端裝鉛鏃，架在三腳架上，兩三人即可抬行，射程在數百步之間；「蠍子」之名來自鐵矢似蠍尾之刺，維特魯維奧在《建築十書》第十卷記述的 cheiroballistra 與 paratenon，是同一技術族最早的文字記錄。到了711年，羅馬的攻城砲已換成皮筋投石車，弩砲退為野戰與守備的輔助兵器，只在少數被援引的戰役與出土實物中留痕。功能上真正可以與它對位的，是瑪雅城邦的投射兵器：擲矛器、投石索、弓箭，同樣單發、必須瞄準，但發力全靠臂力，沒有扭力簧束；帕倫基與托尼納都沒有投石機、撞槌或攻城塔，攻城一方只有繩梯、木斧、火把與鍬。真正值得對照的是攻城器械在政治上的角色：希臘城邦以城牆劃定公民權，城牆一破，城邦即非城邦，故羅馬的弩砲是一件拆城邦的工具；瑪雅城邦的正統載體則是廟宇與碑刻，星際大戰的目標是擒王、焚廟、拆碑、易姓，同樣是把一個政治單體的邊界拆掉——手段一個靠機械，一個靠儀式與人手。托尼納第五露台那條以帕倫基風格製作的俘虜飾帶，說明破城之後連對方的工匠都被帶走，正是兩種拆解方式的共同後果。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Roman scorpio: a single-shot torsion ballista that appears in the first century BC, storing its energy in bundles of sinew and horsehair twisted together and firing one iron bolt about a metre long with a lead head, carried on a tripod that two or three men could lift and move, and reaching a range of a few hundred paces. The name 'scorpion' comes from the resemblance of the bolt to a scorpion's sting, and the cheiroballistra and the paratenon described by Vitruvius in the tenth book of De architectura are the earliest written records of the same family of technology. By 711 the Roman siege artillery had long since given way to the onager; the scorpio had sunk to a supporting piece for field and garrison work and survives only in a few cited campaigns and excavated examples. What can really be set against it functionally is the missile equipment of the Maya city-states: the atlatl, the sling and the bow, equally single-shot and equally in need of aim, but powered by the arm alone and without any torsion bundle. Neither Palenque nor Toniná had stone-throwers, rams or siege towers; the besieging side had nothing but rope ladders, wooden axes, torches and picks. What is really worth setting against each other is the political role of siege engines: the Greek city-state defined its citizenship by its walls, and once the walls fell the city was no longer a city-state, so the Roman bolt-thrower was an instrument for unbuilding a city-state; the Maya city-state carried its legitimacy in temples and stelae instead, and the aim of a star war was to take the ruler, burn the temples, break the stelae and change the dynasty, which likewise takes apart the boundary of a political unit — by machinery in one case, by ritual and manpower in the other. The frieze of bound captives on the fifth terrace at Toniná, carved in Palenque style, shows that after the city fell even the enemy craftsmen were carried away: the common consequence of the two ways of unbuilding.
tactics: 星際大戰在銘文學上的定義不是兩軍對撞的會戰，而是一場以摧毀對方祭祀中心、擒獲其君主為目的的決定性襲擊；出兵時日由王室祭司依金星曆與長紀曆的節點算定，9.13.19.13.3 這個日子就是被選中的目標。地理上，兩城相隔約六十四公里的山地：托尼納踞恰帕斯高地的上升石灰岩脊，海拔八百至九百公尺，易守難攻；帕倫基則落在烏蘇馬辛塔河下游的低地林中，舟運方便而城區沒有完整石牆。八月仍是雨季，泥路與溪流拖慢人背與獨木舟的隊伍，因此托尼納的做法是先以奇襲奪取節奏，再直入城區：破門、登台、擒王，把對方的國王與工匠帶走，碑刻與廟宇就地毀棄或拆運。托尼納在碑上留下被縛俘虜的圓雕與低浮雕，帕倫基一方的損失因此不只在人命，也在雕刻、工匠與正統的載體。破城之後是長期的佔據與消耗：帕倫基此後十年王統空白，直到722年新王加冕；戰爭並未就此結束，帕倫基的銘文還記錄了後來新一場敗績，兩城的爭鬥一直延續到八世紀末。防守一方能倚仗的，是神廟群的高台、廟宇之間的狹道與守軍的投射火力，另有糧秣斷絕與疫病帶來的內部壓力。
tacticsEn: In epigraphic terms a 'star war' is not a set-piece collision between two armies but a decisive raid aimed at destroying the opposing ceremonial centre and taking its ruler prisoner; the date of departure is fixed by the court astronomers from the Venus tables and the nodes of the Long Count, and 9.13.19.13.3 was the day chosen for it. Geographically the two cities were separated by some sixty-four kilometres of highland: Toniná stood on a rising limestone ridge in the Chiapas Highlands at eight hundred to nine hundred metres, easy to defend and hard to approach, while Palenque lay in the lowland forest of the lower Usumacinta, convenient for canoe transport but without a continuous stone enceinte. August is still in the rainy season, and mud roads and swollen streams slow a column of porters and canoes, so Toniná's method was to seize the tempo by surprise and then go straight into the city: breach the entrances, climb the terraces, take the king, carry off the enemy king and his craftsmen, and destroy or carry away the stelae and temples on the spot. Toniná's monuments preserve in-the-round figures and low relief of bound captives, so Palenque's loss was not only in lives but in sculpture, craftsmen and the very vehicles of legitimacy. After the city fell came a long period of occupation and attrition: Palenque was left with a blank dynastic record for ten years until a new king was crowned in 722, and the war did not stop there — the inscriptions of Palenque record a further defeat, and the contest between the two cities ran on into the end of the eighth century. The defenders could rely on the height of the temple platforms, the narrow ways between the sanctuaries and the missile fire of the garrison, together with the internal pressure of cut-off food and disease.
data: 可核對的數字有幾組。日期：公元711年8月28日，瑪雅長紀曆記作9.13.19.13.3，即第九巴克頓、第十三卡特恩、第十九圖恩、第十三烏伊納爾、第三金；以GMT 584283換算約為8月22日前後，與英文字典所記日期有數日之差。人物與年表：帕倫基王統連續可考，基尼奇·坎·喬伊·奇塔姆二世在位於702至711年，戰後十年無王，722年基尼奇·阿卡爾·莫·納布三世加冕；托尼納第四任統治者708年即位，716年與721年兩個時期終結日仍在其統治之下。地理：托尼納在奧科辛戈東十三公里，海拔八百至九百公尺，與帕倫基相距約六十四公里；其大金字塔高約七十四公尺，高過特奧蒂瓦坎的太陽金字塔，核心台地高於廣場數十公尺。遺物：托尼納有百件以上雕刻紀念物，多屬六至九世紀，第122號紀念碑是一塊低浮雕，刻的就是711年擒獲帕倫基國王的被縛俘虜像；帕倫基祭祀中心已探得二點五平方公里，不足一成，仍有逾千座建築未發掘。城址年代：帕倫基廢墟自公元前226年延續到公元799年前後，800年後祭祀中心不再有新建的大工程，農業人口延續數代後被叢林吞沒。系列：碑銘可考的星際大戰共十三場，跨度562至781年，本役為第十一次。戰損與戰俘數目沒有可信記載，碑銘只記勝負、日期與慶典。
dataEn: There are several sets of figures that can be checked. First, the date: 28 August AD 711, recorded in the Maya Long Count as 9.13.19.13.3 — the ninth baktun, thirteenth katun, nineteenth t'un, thirteenth uinal and third kin; converted with the GMT correlation 584283 this falls at about 22 August, a few days off the date given in the English reference works. Second, people and chronology: the Palenque dynasty runs continuously, with K'inich K'an Joy Chitam II reigning from 702 to 711, a blank of ten years in the dynastic record after the war, and the coronation of K'inich Ahkal Mo' Nahb III in 722; the fourth ruler of Toniná acceded in 708 and was still on the throne for the period endings of 716 and 721. Third, geography: Toniná lies thirteen kilometres east of Ocosingo at eight hundred to nine hundred metres, some sixty-four kilometres from Palenque; its great pyramid stands about seventy-four metres high, taller than the Pyramid of the Sun at Teotihuacan, and the core terraces rise several tens of metres above the plaza. Fourth, the finds: Toniná has more than one hundred carved monuments, most of them of the sixth to ninth centuries, and Monument 122 is a low relief showing the bound captive of the Palenque king taken in 711; at Palenque two and a half square kilometres of the ceremonial precinct have been uncovered, less than a tenth of the site, with more than a thousand buildings still unexcavated. Fifth, the life of the cities: the Palenque ruins run from about 226 BC to about AD 799, no new monumental construction took place in the ceremonial centre after 800, and an agricultural population continued for a few generations before the forest took the city. Sixth, the series: at least thirteen star wars are known from inscriptions between 562 and 781, and this is the eleventh. There is no trustworthy figure for losses or prisoners; the monuments record only the outcome, the date and the ceremonies.
cause: 衝突的根子是一條延續百年的宿怨。托尼納與帕倫基是瑪雅西部區彼此最貼鄰的兩大城邦，托尼納的史料把它稱為有記錄歷史中最主要的對頭，兩者長期斷續交兵：687年9月，托尼納的統治者疑被帕倫基的基尼奇·坎·巴蘭姆二世擊敗並擒去；699年，托尼納的基尼奇·巴克納爾·查克以一座下沉球場紀念三次戰勝同一位帕倫基國王。711年的直接背景是雙方的王權更替與失衡：帕倫基自巴卡爾以來百年的擴張在卡拉克穆爾方向受挫，702年接位的基尼奇·坎·喬伊·奇塔姆二世尚未坐穩；托尼納方面，708年即位的新王年紀極輕，掌權集團在停戰與結盟之間積累壓力，699年之後的球場、726至729年的碑記與730年重修先王之墓，顯示這一邊一直在備戰。儀式上，星戰必須挑一個曆法與星象都站得住的日子，9.13.19.13.3 這樣的日子被選中，正是把國家行為改寫成神意程序的一步。深層的原因則是區域權力的空隙：卡拉克穆爾在西部退潮，烏蘇馬辛塔河下游的控制權與其貿易與山資源，遂成了兩城必爭之地。
causeEn: The roots of the conflict lie in a hundred-year-old feud. Toniná and Palenque were the two most closely adjacent city-states of the western Maya region, and the record of Toniná calls Palenque its greatest rival throughout its known history; the two fought sporadically for a long time. In September 687 the ruler of Toniná may have been defeated and taken prisoner by K'inich Kan Balam II of Palenque; in 699 K'inich B'aaknal Chaak of Toniná dedicated a sunken ballcourt to mark three victories over that same Palenque king. The immediate background to 711 was a shift of power on both sides. Palenque's century of expansion since Pakal had run into difficulties in the direction of Calakmul, and the king who took the throne in 702, K'inich K'an Joy Chitam II, was not yet secure; in Toniná the new ruler who acceded in 708 was a very young man, and the group around him had been accumulating pressure in the years of truce and alliance, with the ballcourt of 699, the monuments of 726 to 729 and the rededication of the predecessor's tomb in 730 all showing that this side had been preparing. In ritual terms a star war had to be timed to a day that both the calendar and the stars would bear out, and 9.13.19.13.3 was the day chosen, which was the step by which a political act was rewritten as a procedure of divine will. The deeper cause was a gap in the regional balance of power: with Calakmul ebbing in the west, control of the lower Usumacinta and of the trade and upland resources that ran through it became the prize on which the two cities could not agree.
impact: 711年之後，西部瑪雅區的權力次序被重寫。帕倫基的國王被擒，王統出現十年的空白，直到722年才有新王加冕；而新王是否為舊王的直系後裔並無證據，學者多認為這是一條王統的斷裂，新君靠多年鑽營與對外結盟上位。帕倫基此後的歷史是在敗績中收縮的：銘文還記錄了與托尼納交戰中另一場失利，祭祀中心在八世紀末不再有新建的大工程，農業人口延續數代後，城被叢林吞沒，廢址年代止於799年前後。托尼納則成為烏蘇馬辛塔河下游的主導中心，其圓雕風格與俘虜像在八世紀接連樹立，直到第八任統治者之後才明顯衰落，一座城延續到十世紀才被放棄。文化上的後果更耐人尋味：托尼納第五露台那條飾帶用的是當地砂岩，風格卻屬帕倫基，學者據此推論是從帕倫基帶去的工匠所製——破城之後，城市連同其藝術與人力被整體搬走，這與羅馬破城之後沒收希臘工匠與技術的做法同構。學術上，711年之役連同第122號紀念碑、帕倫基王統名單與托尼納長達百年的碑刻，構成了「星戰是政治單體被拆解」最完整的一例。
impactEn: After 711 the order of power in the western Maya region was rewritten. The king of Palenque was taken prisoner, the dynastic record showed a blank of ten years, and only in 722 was a new king crowned; since there is no evidence that he was a direct descendant of his predecessor, most scholars read this as a break in the dynasty, a ruler who had come to the throne through years of manoeuvring and alliances. What followed for Palenque was contraction in the face of defeat: the inscriptions record a further loss in the fighting with Toniná, the ceremonial centre built no new monumental work after the end of the eighth century, an agricultural population continued for a few generations, and then the forest took the city, its ruins ending at about AD 799. Toniná in turn became the dominant centre of the lower Usumacinta, raising its in-the-round sculpture and its captive figures in the eighth century and declining clearly only after the eighth ruler, the city lasting into the tenth century before it was abandoned. The cultural consequence is the more striking: the frieze on the fifth terrace at Toniná is carved from local sandstone but in Palenque style, so scholars infer that craftsmen carried off from Palenque did the work — after the city fell, the city was carried away entire, art and manpower included, which is structurally the same as Rome confiscating Greek craftsmen and their skills after a sack. Scholarly, the war of 711, with Monument 122, the dynastic list of Palenque and a century of Toniná's monuments, makes the fullest available case that a star war is the dismantling of a political unit.
result: 結果直接而殘酷：公元711年8月28日（長紀曆9.13.19.13.3），托尼納攻入帕倫基，擒獲其國王基尼奇·坎·喬伊·奇塔姆二世，這一役被記為碑銘可考的第十一次「星際大戰」。國王的最終下落沒有定論：英文字典條目說他在托尼納被處決，也有學者認為他被扣作人質，總之再沒有回到帕倫基。勝果極為徹底，直接在敗方王統史上造成十年的空缺。帕倫基的廟宇、碑刻與工匠被毀或被帶走，其上層的統治能力在十年裡中斷，直到722年基尼奇·阿卡爾·莫·納布三世加冕才重新運作，而王統已見斷裂。戰爭沒有就此收束，兩城的爭鬥延續到八世紀末，帕倫基最終在廢墟中沉寂。雙方的死傷數目沒有可信記載，碑銘只記日期、勝負與慶典，不列戰俘與屍數；可以確定的是，這一役既是一次城邦的崩解，也是一次權力與技術的整體轉移：帕倫基失去了王、廟與工匠，托尼納贏得了烏蘇馬辛塔下游的主導位置，並在此後百餘年維持著西部第一城的地位。
resultEn: The outcome was direct and brutal: on 28 August AD 711, recorded as 9.13.19.13.3 in the Long Count, Toniná entered Palenque and took its king K'inich K'an Joy Chitam II prisoner; the war was recorded as the eleventh star war known from inscriptions. The king's final fate is not settled: the English reference works state that he was executed at Toniná, while other scholars hold that he was kept as a hostage; in either case he never returned to Palenque. The victory was so complete that it left a gap of ten years in the dynastic history of the defeated city. Palenque's temples, stelae and craftsmen were destroyed or carried off, and the machinery of its elite government was interrupted for a decade, only to start working again when K'inich Ahkal Mo' Nahb III was crowned in 722, by which time the dynasty was already broken. The war did not stop there: the contest between the two cities ran on into the end of the eighth century, and Palenque finally fell silent among its ruins. There is no trustworthy account of the losses on either side; the monuments give the date, the outcome and the ceremonies, and list neither prisoners nor bodies. What can be stated with confidence is that this war was at once the collapse of a city-state and a wholesale transfer of power and technical skill: Palenque lost its king, its temples and its craftsmen, while Toniná gained the dominant position in the lower Usumacinta and held the rank of the first city of the west for the century that followed.
